sourceText:
Stuff
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, December 5, 2009 - 11:55pm

Ingredients




2 lbs. ground beef (amount depends on size of crock pot)
3 slices potatoes
4 sliced carrots
3 stems cut-up broccoli
1 cut-up cauliflower
4 ounces fresh sliced mushrooms
1 bag frozen corn (can also be fresh or canned)
1/2 onion, sliced
Shredded cabbage to cover top of casserole<
2 cans cream of mushroom soup
8 ounces shredded cheddar cheese

Preparation

1 Layer ingredients in crock in order listed. Spoon soup on top of casserole. Cover soup with cheese. Bake on low all day. Serve with French bread. This dish can be made with any of your favorite vegetables. 2 When you layer the casserole, put the ingredients on the bottom that take longer to cook. Ingredients that do not take long should go on the upper layers.
